name: mechanism_e0
description: E₀'s functional mechanisms — HOW E₀ works, not just WHAT it is (Canon) or WHAT it learned (Bootstrap). 20 mechanisms across 6 functional layers: Navigation, Reflexion, Multi-System, Consolidation, Communication, Orchestration. Typed edges encode operational relationships: enables, triggers, feeds, constrains, part_of.

nodes.label: Historization Engine
nodes.description: Records success/failure traces on every traversed edge (U/F). Asymmetric decay rates (λ_s, λ_f). Computes trace_quality q=(U−F)/(U+F+ε) and trace_load m=U+F. Every other mechanism reads from or writes to historization.

nodes.label: Greedy Navigation
nodes.description: Core decision loop: enumerate admissible edges, compute penalized tension S_eff=Δ·R_eff/(M_H·I), select minimum. Deterministic, local, operates on a single landscape. Falls back to escalation when no admissible edge exists.

nodes.label: Amplitude Overlay
nodes.description: Sums path amplitudes Ψ(p)=e^{-S(p)}·e^{iΘ(p)} over bounded-horizon continuations. Computes intensity I∝|Ψ|² per action. Analysis-only layer — provides alternative ranking (Born sampling) without modifying controller state.

nodes.label: Escalation Recovery
nodes.description: Detects four frontier types: DEAD_END (no edges), FILTERED (all filtered by historization), EXHAUSTED (max steps), OVERLOADED (OI > threshold). Routes to edge proposal, amplitude boost, or peer consultation depending on frontier type.

nodes.label: Overlap Modulation
nodes.description: M_H(x→y) = max(0.2, Σ_z √(v(x,z)·v(z,y))). Greedy divides S_eff by M_H. Rewards well-connected paths. Validated empirically: modulation never harms across 14 domains.

nodes.label: Inertia Modulation
nodes.description: I(e) = 1 − α·(m/(m+μ))·(1−|q|). Penalizes confused edges (|q|≈0 with high load), rewards edges with clear signal. Divides S_eff to steer navigation away from indecisive territory.

nodes.label: Reflexive Edge Proposal
nodes.description: When stuck at a frontier: extracts Δ/R₀ patterns from successful edges, proposes hypothesis edges with confidence-scaled parameters. Stufe 1 (reactive: only on stuck) and Stufe 2 (proactive: anticipates frontiers). Proposed edges persist only if execution succeeds.

nodes.label: Self-Graph
nodes.description: Treats E₀'s own operational cycle (amplitude→born→realization→historization→inertia→transition_field) as a navigable landscape. After each step, records which components participated and the outcome. Reveals which components are effective (high |q|) vs confused (q≈0).

nodes.label: Dual Reflection
nodes.description: Harvests self-graph to diagnose component health: healthy, confused, harmful, or inactive. Recommends deactivation of modulation components (curvature, overlap) when they show persistently negative quality despite sufficient trace load.

nodes.label: Auto-Tuning
nodes.description: Closed-loop parameter optimization: diagnose (self-graph) → perturb (suggest_perturbations) → evaluate (trial matrix) → adopt (apply_config). Uses COMPONENT_PARAMS to scope which parameters each component controls.

nodes.label: Multiverse Coupling
nodes.description: Orchestrates N≥2 coupled E₀ systems with independent landscapes. NoveltyGate: convergence without structural novelty = FAILURE (R_eff rises). Prevents consensus-induced stagnation. Implements Coupling Theorem: closed system cannot escape traps.

nodes.label: Coupling Router
nodes.description: Dynamic partner selection for N>2 universes. RECOVERY mode: argmax trace_quality (best partner). EXPLORATION mode: argmax Δ (most different partner). Self-historizing coupling quality via CouplingSelfGraph.

nodes.label: Cross-Reflexion
nodes.description: When Universe A is stuck, Universe B's experience informs hypothesis edges in A. Extracts Δ/R₀ medians from donor, generates new edges with coupling_discount (0.5). Scoped variant uses donor-side locality for targeted proposals.

nodes.label: Dream Mode
nodes.description: Passive cross-domain pattern recognition. Computes edge fingerprints f(e)=(q,m,I), finds functional equivalences via Hungarian matching + WL recursive neighborhoods. Never mutates any domain. Feeds bridge hypotheses to cross-reflexion.

nodes.label: Structural Entropy
nodes.description: Two-type forgetting: (1) Non-inscription when outcome matches prediction (novelty < threshold). (2) Structural decay: low-anchor edges removed when dormant > τ. Prevents unbounded landscape growth and noise accumulation.

nodes.label: Sleep-Wake Cycle
nodes.description: Parameter-free oscillator: wake (navigate, build experience, T_s rises) → check dream_pressure=T_s/(T_s+μ) → sleep (dream_cycle consolidation + structural decay, T_s drops) → wake. Self-sustaining limit cycle.

nodes.label: Perception Ontology
nodes.description: Models human perception as learnable landscape: 10 visual + 5 language + 7 rendering primitives. Edges encode natural support (emphasis→contrast). Historization reveals which presentation strategies work. Perception tells HOW to interpret; observation tells WHAT to look at.

nodes.label: Communication Intent
nodes.description: Detects 6 intent types from controller state: uncertainty (confused component), decision (transition chosen), pattern (trace growth), request (blocked), status (summary), anomaly (unexpected equivalence). Each intent carries urgency, subject, evidence.

nodes.label: Observation Landscape
nodes.description: Treats information about E₀'s running state as navigable domain. States encode scope (global/local) × depth (topology/field/dynamics/mechanics/interference). Same navigation primitives as any domain — E₀ observes itself the same way it observes anything.

nodes.label: Curriculum Navigator
nodes.description: Decomposes large landscapes into cumulative learning turns using derivation hierarchy. Detects equilibrium (T_s stable) as turn-completion signal. Transfers historization across turns. Optional dream consolidation between turns for knowledge stabilization.
